subject: S19 done: admin console (API + /admin web, migration 0025, one queue registry). Gate, db and e2e green locally twice; CI 44043791069 queued
body:
# S19 done: admin console (ledger task 20261117T041953-lead-48f63c)

## Commits on claude/naadi-shared
- 5ff369c: admin API + migration (now 0025) + /admin web console
- a6c003b: 0024 downgrade fix (lead request 20261117T064154)
- cd9817e: storage-key fixes (uploads, content-private signing), editor/picker fixes, pathway_checks queue, e2e green

## Evidence (local, per decision 20261117T090730)
- Integration gate (`pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s test && uv run pytest -m "not live and not db"`): green on integrate of cd9817e, 1568 API unit tests passed. The first attempt failed on packages/ink probe.test.ts "does not count work that waits…" (10.9 ms vs < 10 ms under load); it passed on retry. That is a timing flake in S12's ink package; S19 does not touch it.
- DB suite (fresh migrations to head, local supabase/postgres + storage-api + auth): all S19 db tests pass. tests/db/test_admin_api.py covers:
  - every /api/admin route returns 401 for anon and 403 for a student (OpenAPI-driven)
  - clients cannot write shared tables or read admin_audit, question_revisions or chapter_section_revisions
  - the live path with no redeploy, drafts hidden, edit + diff + rollback, stale drafts refused, unknown nodes refused with their path
  - media upload, licence gates, YouTube
  - question CRUD + snapshots + workflow + no answer leak to students
  - coverage moves; config edit, history, revert, audit
  - queues: report_issues, generated_media, pathway_checks
  
  Also: rls_coverage, schema_doc, migrations round-trip, live_check.
  Non-S19 db failures on the shared tip, reported to owners:
  - seed live_check counts the `user-upload` source (S20, 20261117T053214)
  - answer-column guard flags ingest/placements/builtin.py (S15, 20261117T074530)
  - planner/ingest graph tests (S15/S16)
  - migration round-trip refuses to drop buckets that hold local e2e files (local state only)
- e2e smoke set, twice in a row, `--retries=0 --workers=2`, projects webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440 on the final build: run 1 `9 passed, 3 skipped (3.7m)`, run 2 `9 passed, 3 skipped (3.6m)`.
  - The 3 skips are the full authoring flow on non-portrait projects (by design: it runs once, on the primary target). That flow: admin adds a chapter, a section, an SVG figure, a PDF, a YouTube video and a question; publishes; a student sees each; edit + rollback; feature_flags edit, history, revert; the coverage cell moves.
  - Every admin page plus the non-admin permission state: zero console errors, frozen-DOM axe clean, no sideways scroll, at most one lime action.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/19, 56 files (14 views × iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone 390, laptop 1440): admin overview, chapters, media, questions, queues, reports, coverage, config, agent-ops, config-feature_flags, question-form, section-editor, queue-decision, permission. ci.yml scans and uploads screens/19.
- CI: run 44043791069 (https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44043791069) for cd9817e is queued in the backlog. Per 20261117T090730, verify on the first green run that contains cd9817e.

## REVIEW_CHECKLIST
- [x] Every UI string is ui_copy (admin.* ≈600 keys in app_config.yaml + REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS; apps/web/src/admin is in noHardcodedCopy.test.ts; defaults regenerated). Server responses are structured: 409 `gate_refused` details carry `["gate", <reason>]`; other 409 codes are stale_draft, stale_parent, stale_write, bad_transition, id_taken, stale_order, not_restorable; 422 node errors give their path.
- [x] One lime CTA per view (checked in e2e). Status is never colour only: chips carry a word and an icon, and coverage cells say Gap, Thin or Covered with an icon.
- [x] Phone 390: no overflow (e2e scrollWidth check; fixed the queue tiles and the table scroll boxes).
- [x] No dead links. pathway_checks, youtube_candidates and question_review are registered. question_review is a path-only queue that links to S21's /admin/review.
- [x] Keyboard: editor shortcuts are TipTap's own; picker search no longer submits a parent form (bug fixed).
- [x] No answer reaches students: admin question routes are require_admin only; the qbank guard allowlists admin/questions.py with a reason; the e2e checks that the student block shows no key or explanation.
- [x] Clients cannot write shared tables: all writes are service-role after require_admin; admin_audit and question_revisions are RLS-forced with no grants; migration 0025 updates rls_coverage and live_check; single alembic head.
- [x] CSP: no inline styles (TipTap tables without colgroup/style; checked in e2e); the TT inert parse uses S22's parseInertHtml.
- [x] No LLM call added. Agent ops shows metadata only: no run inputs, outputs, messages or error text.
- [x] Lint, typecheck, vitest, ruff, mypy, gen:contracts and ui-copy defaults: no drift.
- [x] Local e2e smoke set 2× with --retries=0 (above). Specs wait for responses and saves (trackApi/settle) before navigating.

## Decisions (lead to check)
1. Contract change: chapter_section_revisions gains status draft|published, parent_revision_id, restored_from_id, updated_at, published_at/by.
   - One draft per section (autosave target); published rows are immutable (trigger).
   - The live body is the latest published non-seed revision: a trigger copies it into chapter_sections.body. Seed rows keep their old meaning (the body a seed import replaced).
2. admin_audit holds hashes only, never content: sha256 of before/after. Config PUT is audited after the save, and an audit failure is logged, not surfaced.
3. question_revisions.version is numbered by an insert trigger, so S21's direct insert and S19's snapshot_question agree. Origins: admin, author, review, seed.
4. Licence gates (`naadi_api/admin/licence.py`, pure decide() with a unit-tested matrix):
   - no_source and no_license (blank, unknown, per-item, per-file)
   - copy_not_allowed for hosted copies
   - YouTube: needs the youtube-embed-only licence, embeddable, and metadata ≤ 30 days old
   - NC/ND on paid pages: v1 has no paid pages (paid=false), but the gate is implemented
   - share-alike inside a proprietary chapter is refused
   - non-AI-ingest is excluded from RAG
5. Uploads are a raw request body plus query metadata, because python-multipart is not a dependency.
   - SVG goes through seed/svg.py; rasters are re-encoded to WebP (≤ 4096 px); PDFs go to content-private.
   - Storage uses export.storage.target_from, so the storage-api key is used locally and in CI. chapters_media.py signing was fixed the same way (students previously saw "PDF not available" on bare stacks).
6. One registry for every queue. youtube_candidates and pathway_checks are registered by S19 over S20/S17 functions, with S19 running the licence gates first. question_review is path-only (/admin/review). generated_media uses S19's own approve: S15b's approve_generated writes a figure node with an extra `caption` attr that the strict schema rejects. Asked seg15b, 20261117T050009, no reply yet. It also follows 15b's rules: images only, bucket-relative paths, signed preview.
7. Agent runs and crons are read from Aegra's tables (the Agent Protocol has no "list all runs"). Cancel goes through langgraph-sdk with the admin's own token.
8. ui_copy cap raised from 2000 to 4000 strings: 2081 after S19+S20+S21, about 105 KB under the 256 KB PUT limit.
9. Migration renumbered 0024 → 0025 because S21 took the claimed 0024.
10. A published question whose stem, options or key change goes back to in_review with stats reset (authoring_rules Part C rule 7). Publish is refused on S21 lint errors.
